mapper.sql: id, conversation_id, sender_id, sender_role, msg_type, content_type, content, media_url, file_name, file_size, is_read, created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO msg_message (conversation_id, sender_id, sender_role, msg_type, content_type, content, media_url, file_name, file_size) VALUES (#{conversationId}, #{senderId}, #{senderRole}, #{msgType}, #{contentType}, #{content}, #{mediaUrl}, #{fileName}, #{fileSize})
mapper.update: UPDATE msg_message SET is_read = 1 WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND sender_id != #{userId} AND is_read = 0
mapper.select: SELECT FROM msg_message WHERE conversation_id IN ( SELECT id FROM msg_conversation WHERE (candidate_id = #{userId} OR hr_id = #{userId}) ) AND sender_id != #{userId} AND is_read = 0 ORDER BY created_at ASC
